capabilities.label: Structure
capabilities.detail: Tasks, subtasks, to-do lists, folders, projects, Spaces (locked/private), Space templates, cross-tagging (categorize across folders without duplication), custom fields, calculated fields (Budget/Cost/ROI), custom statuses, per-phase workflows

capabilities.label: Custom Item Types
capabilities.detail: company/team libraries with custom names/icons; ESM types (Service Requests/KB Articles/Surveys), OKR types, Agile types (Bugs/Epics/Features/Sprints/Stories); per-type business logic/automation
features: company/team libraries with custom names/icons; ESM types (Service Requests/KB Articles/Surveys)

capabilities.label: Views
capabilities.detail: Table, List (hierarchical), Board/Kanban, Gantt/timeline, Calendar, Chart, Workload, File, Dashboard, Stream; per-member Primary View; dynamic filters; saved/shareable custom views
features: Stream; per-member Primary View; dynamic filters; saved/shareable custom views

capabilities.label: Gantt/scheduling
capabilities.detail: interactive timelines, dependencies, critical path, milestones, real-time adjustment, drag-drop rescheduling, bottleneck ID

capabilities.label: Automation

capabilities.label: Workload/resource
capabilities.detail: Workload charts, resource bookings/time reservations, Effort management, capacity balancing, idle-time prevention, advanced resource/capacity planning, job/role management

capabilities.label: Time tracking/budgeting
capabilities.detail: time tracking by role, timelog, billable hours, project/portfolio/client budgeting, cost monitoring, invoice management, forecasting

capabilities.label: Portfolio
capabilities.detail: portfolio overview (charts/progress), portfolio budgets, cross-project roll-up reporting

capabilities.label: Goals/OKRs
capabilities.detail: OKRs dashboard, Company OKRs dashboard (strategy alignment), OKR custom item templates

capabilities.label: Dashboards/analytics
capabilities.detail: ready-made + custom dashboards, widget library, chart types, mobile dashboards, real-time + scheduled reports, comparison reports (trend over periods), PDF export, advanced analytics/BI (360° reports), instant alerts

capabilities.label: Agile

features: Wrike Sync / Two-Way Sync (22+ systems incl. Jira/GitHub)
